name: Content
intro: Content is your saved shelf in SmartVideo. It keeps the generations you saved, files you uploaded, PDFs and stock media, all in one place.

features.save-to-content: Press Save on a studio result or in Library, and the item lands here under the Saved tab with its prompt and model. It's the easy way to mark your keepers.
features.browse-stock-media: Browse Stock Media opens a picker of free Pexels images and videos. Choose one and it's saved here with the photographer credit, ready for backgrounds and b-roll.
features.upload: Use the upload button to add your own files to Content. It's a handy place to keep references and documents you want close by.
features.preview: Click any item to see it large, whether it's an image, a video, audio or a PDF. The preview shows its details and has a Download button.
features.remove-delete: Hover over an item and press the red delete button to tidy up. Removing a saved item only takes it off this shelf, and it stays in your Library.

outro: That's Content. Save what you love, keep your references handy, and download the files that matter most.
